manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A tossed ball and a ball released from rest at the top are shown side by side with velocity and acceleration arrows. At the top the velocity is zero but the acceleration is still -g.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.description: Two lanes share one height scale. The tossed ball rises and falls while a gate holds the second ball at the top height. When the toss reaches its top, the gate opens and both balls fall together.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At top jumps to the shared release.
